digest.component_or_area: PydanticAIRunner.run() method and llm module structure
propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() is 342 lines (49% of runner.py) and contains four separable kwargs construction fragments and two post-call telemetry blocks that can be extracted without logic changes.

build_agent_kwargs, log_call_success, and record_call_spend must be extracted from run() into a new leaf module agent_call.py to respect the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor while avoiding structured_run.py exceeding its 500-LOC target.

The _anthropic_web_search_capabilities call site must remain in runner.py (not extracted) because it is a module-global that the suite patches via monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, ...) and moving the call would silently defeat the patch.

The extracted functions share no inter-dependencies but are cohesive as the three edges of one Agent call—the kwargs handed to Agent(...) and the two records emitted after it returns—and together reduce run() from 342 to 300 lines.

Zero monkeypatch repoints are required because all patched runner globals remain in runner.py; the relocation is pure code movement with no logic changes or signature modifications crossing module boundaries.
